title: An investor answers in the founder's other mailbox - both are read, and the file says so

objects.subject: Nimbus Labs - raising our seed round
objects.body:
Hi Ravi,

Nimbus Labs is raising a seed round to bring calendar-aware planning to small teams. Could we find 20 minutes next week?

Arjun

objects.subject: Re: Nimbus Labs - raising our seed round

Thanks for reaching out. Could you send the deck before we speak?

Ravi Iyer
Seedfund Partners

notes: STEP-10 (06 D40): the golden set had one mailbox. The founder pitched from his personal Gmail; the investor answered his company address. Read from one mailbox, the pitch is unanswered and 'no reply' would be said; read from both, the answer is in the file and the move is ours. The file's receipt names both connections (tests/replays/test_every_number_says_its_n.py). A reply that arrives in another mailbox opens another conversation, so it is not paired with the pitch as a reply time - declared, not hidden.
